analysis.summary: Aimtron Electronics Limited released its investor presentation for H1 and FY27, detailing operational metrics, financial results, and strategic growth avenues. The company reported a consolidated revenue of Rs 2,247.1 Mn for H1 FY27, reflecting an 83.3% year-on-year increase, along with an EBITDA of Rs 486.1 Mn. Management outlined various sectoral focuses including industrial automation, aerospace, defence, medical technology, and electric vehicles, alongside backward integration initiatives. Furthermore, the company highlighted a strong order book standing at Rs 7.3 Bn as of September 30, 2026. Aimtron Electronics Limited reported H2 FY26 consolidated revenue from operations of ₹1,786 million, EBITDA of ₹369 million, and profit after tax of ₹257 million, with full-year FY26 consolidated revenue growing 89.2% year-on-year to ₹3,012 million.

guidance.claim: Management targets a 40% to 50% CAGR growth rate and a journey toward ₹1,000 crores over the next couple of years.
guidance.quote: Probably we'll keep our strategy in line with 40%, 50% CAGR growth because next couple of years with this year, I would say, next couple of years, we eyeing on ₹1,000 crores kind of a journey.

guidance.claim: The company expects Aimtron International Controls (AIC) to reach a peak revenue of $25 million to $30 million.
guidance.quote: So on peak, we can take it up to ₹25 million to ₹30 million. That is what we are eyeing on from specific to AIC, Aimtron International Controls.

guidance.claim: Aimtron International Controls is projected to achieve approximately $17 million in revenue for FY27.
guidance.quote: And this year will be somewhere around ₹17 million approximately. That is what we are eyeing in to.

guidance.claim: Management targets a sustained 40-50% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: targeting sustained 40–50% CAGR over the next 3–5 years

demand_outlook.claim: India demand for small form factor pluggables is aggregating and is expected to reach up to 40G capacity range.
demand_outlook.quote: Probably, India demand is getting aggregated and it's expected like to go up to 40G capacity range. And that is what we are also advancing in that direction.

demand_outlook.claim: The company gained a trusted telecom partner status and encountered railway orders with RDSO approvals expected in upcoming quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: And railways also, we started encountering the orders and RDSO approvals will takes place in the next couple of quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: The AI dashboard camera used in Gujarat State Road Transportation is expected to roll over pan-India down the line.
demand_outlook.quote: And down the line, that is expected to get rolled over in pan-India, again, not immediately, but down the line, that's what.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong traction in the oil and gas sector with 424 prototypes done last year.
demand_outlook.quote: So oil and gas, probably now we are looking at something on a higher side because last year, if I see just giving you a number, we did almost 424 prototypes.

capex_expansion.claim: Management highlighted a greenfield project for Aimtron Mechatronics.
The greenfield Mechatronics facility will feature an initial setup with two SMT lines, expanding to four SMT lines.
capex_expansion.quote: But Mechatronic will have another setup with two SMT lines to start with and four SMT lines over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the Mechatronics facility is ongoing with the mechanical part expected to be operational in Q3 or Q4 of the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: So currently, we have Fuji platform both at Vadodara as well as Bangalore. And the new greenfield project that we are coming up with also will be the same Fuji platform itself that's in Japanese made. And as of now, like collaboration is completed and constructions are ongoing. So, that facility construction is done. Probably it will be Q3 and Q4.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established Aimtron Electronics LLC in Texas as a wholly owned subsidiary to access new markets.
capex_expansion.quote: Established Aimtron Electronics LLC in Texas, USA, as a wholly owned subsidiary to access and cater new markets.

capex_expansion.claim: A greenfield Vadodara facility was constructed featuring 6 SMT lines and a dedicated ODM R&D zone.
capex_expansion.quote: Greenfield Vadodara facility under construction featuring 6 SMT lines (phased rollout) + dedicated ODM R&D zone (Aug 2025)

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin stood at 22.6% and PAT margin stood at 15.3% for FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin stood at 22.6% in FY '26. PAT margin stood at 15.3% in FY '26.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin is expected to remain in the 20% to 22% range.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA 20% to 22% kind of a range will be intact on the consolidation mode.

orders_capacity.claim: The closing order book as on 30th Sep, 2026 was 7,333 Mn.
The RFQ Pipeline stands at approximately USD 40 Mn.
The RFQ Pipeline is INR 14+ Bn.
The open pipeline of RFQs and orders stands at approximately $70 to $80 million.
orders_capacity.quote: And if you look at our open order book and pipeline right now is almost $70 to $80 million just worth of pipeline we have.

orders_capacity.claim: The closing order book as on 31st March 2026 was Rs 5,212 Mn.
The RFQ pipeline stood at USD 49.3 Mn.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised INR 945.7 Mn through convertible warrants in September 2025 as potential growth capital.
capital_allocation.quote: Convertible Warrants (Sep 2025) → Raised INR 945.7 Mn as a potential growth capital

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve RDSO approvals for railway orders in the first half or third quarter of the year.
management_commitments.quote: And RDSO is something that is under progress and probably this year by first half or probably by third quarter, we expect to make a closure on that part.

management_commitments.claim: The Mechatronics facility construction is expected to be operational for mechanical parts in Q3 or Q4 of the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are planning to get it operational by Q3 FY '27 for the mechanical part and assembly line will be after that in Phase 2.

management_commitments.claim: An additional SMT line is planned to be added by the end of FY27 or latest by Q1 of the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: FY '27 or Q1 next financial year, latest by that time.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets a sustained 40-50% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: targeting sustained 40–50% CAGR over the next 3–5 years

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
